questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All shrubs are trees.

Some plants are shrubs.

**Conclusions:**

I. All plants are trees.

II. Some trees are shrubs.

III. No plant is a tree.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Either conclusion I or III follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/277b5f5e0c727991f4c9a47b3b9e52467cdbfe3b4f96738dee4d7974564a865c.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All plants are trees → Does not follow (As all shrubs are trees and some plants are shrubs. As whole shrubs comes in trees and has some part common with plants, so it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some trees are shrubs → **F**ollow (As all shrubs are trees. As whole shrubs comes in trees, therefore it is true.)

III. No plant is a tree → Does not follow (As all shrubs are trees and some plants are shrubs. As whole shrubs comes in trees and has some part common with plants, therefore it is false.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
How many triangles are there in the figure given below?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5ca5f3cbb6c6032796be07a223d096cc007252c3b23ef10c9db443674ba38bf.png]
questions.solution:
The number of triangles in the given figure is shown below:

1) Number of triangles = Number of parts × Number of diagonals

= 4 × 2 ⇒ 8

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7e6dac90d80655dd0910684194a6f9818a226d7b2e3cf0c08e3dc192491226e.png] 

2) Number of triangles = Number of parts × Number of diagonals

= 4 × 2 ⇒ 8

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90e48bb8b3c0c3851ba62ba26d66b1b7080b9fb1b67a543d2a4b7e4866dad6b1.png] 

3) Number of triangles = [Number of parts × (1 + Number of parts)] ÷ 2

= [2 × (1 + 2)] ÷ 2

= [2 × 3] ÷ 2

= 6 ÷ 2

= 3

As there are 2 same types of triangles, therefore total number of triangles will be (3 × 2) = 6 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aca86df8ffa71ff2bb217353157f1a08bcd0470f308309d49b54cb6063334520.png] 

4) Number of triangles = 4

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dafaa9ad20753a92cf99d656b6c2a44eb16b2895d4ced0a8cf4cbcd063e38bf7.png] 

Thus, there are a total of (8 + 8 + 6 + 4) = 26 triangles.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the given sets.

(**NOTE :** Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g., 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding / deleting / multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.

(101, 106, 111)

(214, 198, 182)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **(1st number + 3rd number) ÷ 2 = 2nd number**.

Now,

For (101, 106, 111):

⇒ (101 + 111) ÷ 2 = 212 ÷ 2 = 106.

For (214, 198, 182)

⇒ (214 + 182) ÷ 2 = 396 ÷ 2 = 198.

Similarly, for **(163, 156, 149):**

**⇒ (163 + 149) ÷ 2 = 312 ÷ 2 = 156.**

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

questions.question: O, P, Q, R, W and X are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. W sits second to the left of R. Q sits to the immediate left of W. O sits to the immediate left of X. Who sits to the immediate left of R?
questions.solution:
Given: O, P, Q, R, W and X are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 

1) W sits second to the left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb8fc6ed78a87bb5dccc452369f517daeddb69f035dfc1d0033d1cbfc5e6c609.png] 

2) Q sits to the immediate left of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/012016627c709ad2f3ce1f0e53d53adaa4c5be8a312439b9f177d613b4565267.png] 

3) O sits to the immediate left of X.

After positioning O and X only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/843c8c5bed4d29cb4a4e10815763d19900dbba4c9ece3f5ce250a271bc301e68.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, P sits to the immediate left of R.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
